Берегитесь, как бы французы не взяли над вами реванш за Сицилийскую вечерню."}],"review":[{"source_id":"id06955","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06956","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06957","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06958","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Agency, address and tone preserved."},{"source_id":"id06959","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06960","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful, including the pause and the fixed gaze."},{"source_id":"id06961","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06962","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06963","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06964","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Acceptable idiom for 'Comment cela?'."},{"source_id":"id06965","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful; formal third-person address kept."},{"source_id":"id06966","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06967","verdict":"PASS","reason":"All details of the costume and the agent of the action preserved."},{"source_id":"id06968","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06969","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful."},{"source_id":"id06970","verdict":"CORRECTED","reason":"The draft replaced the formal 'Votre Éminence' with 'вы'/'вы сами', losing the register and the embedded reported structure.
